mandatory_constraints.constraint: Same partner ID must not determine target across context, seed, or counterfactual splits.
Re-label partner IDs; a valid route should be invariant or recover through history while ID lookup fails.
Heldout must include partners absent from training if the claim involves cross-partner transfer.
Heldout contexts must not be reducible to training context lookup.
Same partner key with changed latent cause must force different target behavior.
Different partner keys with the same latent cause must force shared target behavior.
History volume and table construction must not be enough to solve heldout.
Surface-nearest trace retrieval must fail on heldout and counterfactual pairs.
Bounded local history must fail when latent update or intervention is required.
Target cannot be decoded from generated fields, row order, filenames, context IDs, serialized state, or helper literals.
Removing or shuffling intervention feedback must change future correct predictions.
Removing transfer phase must block the claimed evidence target.
Cheap baselines must run before candidate code in any future task family.
Leakage scanner must detect injected visible-label, partner-ID, preference-table, serialized-state, filename/order, and helper-literal leaks.
Replay must recompute behavior from serialized state plus observation, not compare stored hashes.
Thresholds and baseline inventory must be locked before baseline results.
The strongest faithful baseline must be the primary contrast; weaker baselines cannot be selected as main comparison.

forbidden_future_shortcuts: candidate implementation before stronger baseline-first design
